end.summary:
Read and wrote 4-digit numbers using place-value parts in two easy questions.
Practised reading numbers such as 2345 and 7608 aloud and in numerals.
Zero as a place holder and the value of each digit were discussed but not yet checked with a why or new-situation question.
Teach-back was not passed; the zero/place-value explanation was still unsettled at the end.
end.parentNote: Diya practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers by separating thousands, hundreds, tens and ones, and got the two easy questions right. They mixed up why zero is used and what place a digit holds; this was not yet corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, use numbers such as 4,050 and 5,020 and ask Diya to name each digit's place and explain what the zero shows.
